files.prompt: A single isolated production sample sprite for original 2D Chinese post-apocalypse survival PC game 适者生存. Genuine transparent alpha background, clear empty transparent margin on all sides, no backdrop, no floor, no painted black background, no frame, no typography, no numbers, no watermark. Darkest Dungeon 1 angular ink woodcut aesthetic combined with strong chunky deliberately stepped pixel clusters, dramatic jet-black planes and hard bone-ivory highlights, low saturation limited palette, distressed rusty ochre and subdued olive. Straight pixel edges, clear silhouette at thumbnail size, no soft gradients, no blur. Centered, entire object inside frame. A worn clean water plastic bottle, pale slate blue transparent water suggested using opaque highlights, muted cyan blue cap, asymmetrical crumpled sides, no printed label. Slight diagonal, large isolated inventory icon, nearly square canvas.
